proposed_comments.title: Gate clipboard history loads until the page is requested

confidence.rationale: The current event handler starts a complete history read and image-cache write on every clipboard change even though the provider constructs the page before the user opens it. The converged fork added an explicit page-requested gate while preserving a dirty flag for the first page load.

proposed_comments.body:
### Gate clipboard history loads until the page is requested

**Severity:** `high`

The provider subscribes this page to `Clipboard.HistoryChanged` during construction, so this handler starts `GetHistoryItemsAsync`, image decoding, and disk-cache writes for every clipboard change even when the user has never opened Clipboard History. Track whether the page has been requested and keep the event handler to a cheap dirty-mark until then; the first `GetItems()` call should still load the latest history.

proposed_comments.title: Preserve the image preview when disk caching fails

confidence.rationale: CacheImageAsync catches failures and returns no success signal, but the caller assigns ImagePath before the cache attempt. The fork fix only publishes the path after a successful write and retains the stream-backed hero image when caching is unavailable.

proposed_comments.body:
### Preserve the image preview when disk caching fails

**Severity:** `high`

`CacheImageAsync` swallows write failures, but `ImagePath` is assigned before the call. A failed or incomplete cache therefore leaves a non-null path that `DetailsMarkdownHelper` renders, while `ClipboardListItem` does not create a `HeroImage` fallback; the image details pane can become blank. Publish `ImagePath` only after a confirmed cache write, or preserve the existing stream-backed preview whenever caching fails.

proposed_comments.title: Queue a reload when a request arrives during an active load

confidence.rationale: The current method returns immediately when loadInFlight.Set fails without recording the new request. The fork fix records reloadRequested under synchronization, preventing a request during a failed or active load from being lost.

proposed_comments.body:
### Queue a reload when a request arrives during an active load

**Severity:** `high`

When `loadInFlight.Set()` returns false, this method exits without recording that the caller still needs a refresh. If `GetItems()` or a clipboard event arrives while a load is active—especially while a failed load is about to clear `hasLoadedOnce`—the trailing request can be lost and the page remains stale until another clipboard event. Set `reloadRequested` while observing the in-flight state, then start the trailing load from the completion path.

proposed_comments.title: Serialize disposal with starting the clipboard worker

confidence.rationale: Dispose and StartClipboardHistoryLoad currently read and write the lifecycle flags without a shared synchronization boundary. The converged fork rechecks disposal immediately before setting loading state and starting the STA thread, and performs cleanup after the in-flight state is released.

proposed_comments.body:
### Serialize disposal with starting the clipboard worker

**Severity:** `high`

`loadInFlight` is set before this method, but `Dispose()` can win the race before `SetLoadingState(true)` and `thread.Start()`. The worker can then start after the page has been disposed, update loading state, perform clipboard/cache work, and leave cleanup dependent on an unsynchronized flag read. Recheck `disposed` while holding the same synchronization used for the in-flight transition immediately before starting the worker, clear the in-flight state when disposal wins, and run deferred cache cleanup after the worker exits.

actions.label: Request changes with four current-head fixes

review.body: Thanks for the clipboard-history preview work and the asynchronous loading improvements. Before merge, please address four current-head correctness items: defer event-driven history loads until the page is requested; preserve the stream-backed image preview when disk caching fails; queue reloads that arrive during an active load; and serialize disposal with starting the STA worker so disposed pages cannot start new work or race cache cleanup.
